high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of a tweet from BAI Media (@BAI_Media) announcing a significant achievement in badminton. The tweet is marked as "BREAKING" and highlights Ayush Shetty's victory at the Yonex US Open 2025, where he won his maiden BWF Super300 title. Header: The tweet is from BAI Media, an official account for the Badminton Association of India. The handle @BAI_Media is displayed with a blue verification checkmark. There is a green WhatsApp icon
